body:
Redline round 2

Reviewed only the fix diff from round 1 (58c0666..a276f2b).

This round's fixes close both round 1 findings and introduce no new defects. For R1-1, the relaunch rule now names the in-session relaunch of a stopped run and counts the person's last typed line rather than the relaunching turn. SKILL.md section 2 now splits error and stopped resumes (which relaunch from the command line) from handoff and reviewed resumes (which relaunch from the word), and README.md says the same, in line with "stopped before a result". For R1-2, a reshape's checkCalls now receives the round's calls, which are all decided by the time a reshape runs because settle hands off otherwise. So a decided ask may leave out its call, or keep the call beside a finding the reshape sorted differently. A new ask with no call, or a new call on a fix, still stops at shape. A forced-ask call from the first shape is covered too, since it is in `calls`. The five new loop-test scenarios cover each case. I traced them from the code but could not run them, because the reviewer role may not run node.

No findings.
